response.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT s.transref, t.trdref, tr.tradekind, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg), overall AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS overall_avg FROM base), pairs AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS pair_avg FROM base GROUP BY transref, tradekind), devs AS (SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.pair_avg, ABS(p.pair_avg - o.overall_avg) AS dev FROM pairs p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND p.tradekind IS NOT NULL), typed AS (SELECT d.tradekind, d.pair_avg, d.dev, AVG(d.dev) OVER (PARTITION BY d.tradekind) AS type_avg_dev FROM devs d), kept AS (SELECT tradekind, pair_avg, dev, dev - type_avg_dev AS excess FROM typed WHERE dev > type_avg_dev) SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_avg) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(dev) AS avg_deviation, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind
